turns.tutor:
The rule: ask politely with Can I have ... or I would like ..., and add please.
Right: "Can I have a red balloon, please?"
Wrong: "Give me a red balloon."
I think aloud about the wrong one.
First, it starts with Give me. That is an order.
Next, I look for please. It is not there.
So it is not polite.
Your turn. Make this polite:
"Give me a coffee."
